theatrical.title: Theatrical Releases
theatrical.description: These settings map directly to TMDB Discover movie filters. Multiple release types and genres use OR logic.

data_description.theatrical_exclude_rereleases: When enabled, a movie is shown only if TMDB's primary release date falls between today and the configured number of days. This filters out older movies returning to theaters.
data_description.theatrical_certification: Select any certifications to include. Multiple selections use OR logic.

data_description.digital_certification: Select any certifications to include. Multiple selections use OR logic.

tv.title: TV Shows
tv.description: Configure shows airing in the selected date window. Providers and genres use OR logic within each group.

general.description: Choose how often Entertainment Releases refreshes TMDB data.
